name: Saint of the Moonlight
source:
Some would do anything to be considered a saint. Demetra is not one of those people.

Follow Demetra after she's been declared a saint; your choices will determine whether she accepts or denies this new twist of fate. 

[From [url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/saint-of-the-moonlight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有些人为了被尊为圣人，愿意不择手段。Demetra却不在此列。

跟随被宣布为圣人的Demetra，见证她此后的经历。你的选择，将决定她接受还是拒绝这突如其来的命运转折。

[摘自[url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/saint-of-the-moonlight]itch.io[/url]]
